name: builder-blueprints
description: Builder Blueprints — skills that help AI builders ship real products: a Next.js website with strong SEO, an AI plugin, a Three.js game with Blender assets, an MCP server, and a Node.js API. Each blueprint interviews you, gives your coding agent the best-practice reference to build from, audits the result against a checklist, and writes a launch guide for what you actually built.
